severity: ROOT CAUSE of 'the policy never presses the plunger' -- the reward never asked it to
claim: The scene's `object` is not a passive cylinder: it is an IsaacLab Articulation whose prismatic `PistonJoint` IS the pipette plunger. The v1 reward reads only rigid-body positions (body_pos_w) and never reads joint_pos, so depressing the plunger -- the functional act the task is named for -- was never measured, never rewarded, and never required for 'success'.
discovery: Found by direct scene enumeration after a visual observation that the policy 'is not pressing the plunger'. The observation was correct and the metric was blind to it.

scene_facts.Rod: the PLUNGER; also the articulation ROOT link (the part the robot grasps)
scene_facts.Barrel: the pipette body; the rod slides through its bore
scene_facts.drive: passive spring+damper with rest target 0.0 -- returns to rest when released

what_v1_scored: reach, grasp, lift, tube-proximity, plate-proximity, settle -- all from positions. v1 'success' = pipette carried over the pot and settled. Neither insertion nor plunger actuation is tested. Consistent with the manifest: every screened demonstration scores success:True with tube:False.
consequence_for_rl: The RL policies optimised exactly what was scored. A reward with no plunger term provides no gradient toward pressing the plunger, so the absence of pressing in the learned policy is expected behaviour, not a training failure.
validity_of_prior_results: All v1 numbers remain valid UNDER THE V1 PREDICATE (transport-based). v1 is frozen, not edited, so every prior claim stays reproducible; v2 is a separate module and every rollout can be scored under both.
fix: rlinf/envs/isaaclab/tasks/g1_piston_reward_v2.py: adds press (plunger > 50% travel while held) and dispense (press while aligned over the tube) stages, tightens the tube stage to a real insertion tolerance with a height gate, and closes the v1 lift exploit with a ballistic-speed test. Plunger shaping is best-so-far so the spring-loaded joint cannot be pumped for reward (pinned by test_pumping_the_spring_loaded_plunger_cannot_farm_reward).
demonstration_measurement: IN PROGRESS -- replaying all 11 demo episodes logging PistonJoint position.
